title: Binary GCD Total Cost Model Formalization

problemStatement.formal: Let stepCount(a, b) count iterations of Stein's binary GCD algorithm and bitsPerStep(a, b) bound the bit-operations in one step. Define totalCost(a, b) = stepCount(a, b) * bitsPerStep(a, b), then formalize the established asymptotic cost analysis for that total bit-operation model in Lean 4.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize a total bit-operation cost model for Stein's binary GCD algorithm by measuring total cost as step count times bit-operations per step, then connect that model to known asymptotic analyses.
whyMatters: Turns established binary GCD cost analysis into an explicit Lean 4 formalization target rather than an open-ended conjecture.
Exercises algorithmic complexity and bit-operation modeling around existing GCD infrastructure.
Helps expose what Mathlib support exists or is missing for step counts, bit lengths, and computational cost models.

proven: Classical sources analyze Stein's binary GCD / binary Euclidean algorithm costs; the local literature notes cite Knuth TAOCP Vol. 2 Section 4.5.2 and Brent 1976.
The selection report treats the mathematics as established and identifies the challenge as encoding the cost model in Lean 4.
